[[Euroleague]] | team = Lietuvos rytas | team_link = BC Lietuvos rytas | number = 16 | nationality = Serbian | birth_date = {{Birth date and age|1991|6|16}} | birth_place = [[Nova Varoš]], [[Socialist Republic of Serbia|SR Serbia]], [[Socialist Federal Republic of Yugoslavia|SFR Yugoslavia]] | college = | draft = | draft_year = | draft_team = | career_start = 2008 | career_end = | years1 = 2008–2012 | team1 = [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]] | years2 = 2012–present | team2 = [[Lietuvos Rytas Vilnius]] | awards = * [[Lithuanian Basketball League|LKL]] All-Star ([[2013 LKL All-Star Game|2013]]) }} '''Nemanja Nedović''' ({{IPA-sh|němaɲa nêːdoʋitɕ|pron}}) ([[Serbian Cyrillic alphabet|Serbian Cyrillic]]: Немања Недовић, born 16 June 1991 in [[Nova Varoš]], [[SFR Yugoslavia]]) is a [[Serbia|Serbian]] professional [[basketball]] player for [[Lietuvos Rytas Vilnius]] of the [[Lietuvos Krepšinio Lyga|Lithuanian Basketball League]]. ==Career== Nedović began to train in [[Italy]] at Ascoli basket when he was 11 years of age. He lived there because his father was playing professional [[Team handball|handball]] locally. After that, two years trained to BC from [[Nova Varoš]]. In 2005 came to [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star Belgrade]] and soon showed great talent. He had great success in the junior competition, as in 2008, when he was champion with the junior team of [[KK Crvena zvezda|Red Star]]. After that he moved to the first team where he was playing until June 2012, when he signed with [[Lietuvos Rytas Vilnius]].{{cite web|title=Lietuvos Rytas inks Nedovic|url=http://www.euroleague.net/news/i/98378/180/lietuvos-rytas-inks-nedovic|work=Euroleague|accessdate=4 August 2012}} ==Serbian national team== Nedović was member of [[Serbia men's national under-20 and under-21 basketball team|U20 Serbia national basketball team]] in 2009, 2010 and 2011 at [[FIBA Europe Under-20 Championship]].
